name: workers-sdk
description: Calibrated from steps 1-2 for corpus 'workers-sdk'. Rates are measured on that corpus; agent, CI and failure parameters are the defaults.

sources.file-oracle: step 2 oracle_file, module level, view all
sources.module-oracle: step 2 oracle_module, module level, view all
sources.module-level: step 2 'combined' at its tuned module threshold
sources.predicted: step 2 knn p>=0.2, granularity d3, view substantive (lowest clean-flag rate with conflict recall within 0.05 of 0.6, title only)
sources.hot-file-rule: ASSUMED scenario (orchestrator): serialise only the few files that dominate conflicts

notes: q_sem not measured by step 1; kept the default and swept by experiments.py.
conflict_model per_file: per-shared-file probabilities fitted on step 1's file-class pairs (entangled pairs excluded).

pair-level placement at step 2's measured operating point [0.5812, 0.1733] (step 2 knn p>=0.2, granularity d3, view substantive (lowest clean-flag rate with conflict recall within 0.05 of 0.6, title only)).
prediction_model empirical: step 2's 'combined' predicted sets at threshold 0.416 for 643 changes (eval split); tasks are bootstrapped from those changes.
zipf_s fitted so the simulated share of file-sharing pairs among module-sharing pairs matches step 1.
